expectations.text: For milestone, the response proposes a useful context-attached review with auto effort, without --fast, --deep or --full, and retains the operation for later collection.
expectations.evidence: B.md:5-18 proposes an auto checkpoint with relevant context and no effort/freshness flags; B.md:96-101 retains and polls each operation.

expectations.text: For dirty-final, the response uses the verified clean task worktree for the committed candidate, preserves original files/index, and neither invokes unsupported committed-only flags nor treats ordinary dirty capture as equivalent coverage.
expectations.evidence: B.md:24-37 selects the verified clean worktree, rejects original dirty capture, preserves files/index and rules out invented committed-only flags.

expectations.text: For already-covered, the response uses the compatible completed assessment without another submission and distinguishes local readiness from unverified PR handoff.
expectations.evidence: B.md:41-43 reuses completed compatible coverage without submission and limits readiness to local, not hosted PR review, CI or merge.

expectations.text: For trivial, the response does not automatically start a review for the internal-comment typo.
expectations.evidence: B.md:47 explicitly says no review command or context submission for the behavior-neutral typo.

expectations.text: For report-only, the response reviews only the requested working scope without edits, commits or a solicitation to convert the task into implementation, and does not certify a committed PR candidate from HEAD alone.
expectations.evidence: B.md:51-62 preserves the requested uncommitted scope, identifies the working snapshot rather than HEAD alone and prohibits edits, commits, PR preparation and implementation solicitation.

expectations.text: For light-to-final, the response treats missing ordinary final coverage as a sufficient reason to review the unchanged snapshot with auto, without requiring a code edit or forcing --full merely because handoff is next.
expectations.evidence: B.md:66-79 explicitly proceeds despite unchanged code to obtain missing final coverage using default auto, without forced --full.

expectations.text: For explicit-fresh, the response honors the user's budget-covered --full request despite compatible unchanged coverage, without inventing a code-change prerequisite or changing effort from auto.
expectations.evidence: B.md:83-93 honors the within-budget request despite existing coverage; the command includes --full but neither effort flag, and freshness is distinguished from depth.

expectations.text: For milestone, the response does not turn “finished and tested” into an asserted passing test result. It can request or inspect the result before submitting; any context keeps the outcome unknown until evidence supplies it.
expectations.evidence: B.md:17 states that test commands and outcomes are unspecified; B.md:7 does not assert that tests passed.

claims.claim: Commands without effort flags use auto; --full requests freshness rather than deep effort.
The Engine determines continuation eligibility for light-to-final.
claims.evidence: B.md:79 proposes this behavior, but neither the prompt nor supplied CLI help establishes Engine continuation eligibility. Unverified, not contradicted.

suggestions.reason: Retention is asserted only for milestone. Add a cross-case assertion requiring collection of every submitted operation without resubmission and withholding readiness for incomplete inventory. B.md:96-106 addresses this currently unscored behavior.

eval_feedback.overall: All eight assertions pass as proposals. No material invented task facts found; Engine continuation semantics remain unsupported by the supplied evidence. Execution success is not established or inferred.

grader_provenance.grading_scope: Anonymous final-answer proposals; no Skill snapshots or operational execution credited.
